chapters: Jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii ka't gu suudai' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jix duñia' daam.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt gu Salomoon bɨx gu Israeel bopxi'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu Israeel ɨɨbhidham gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Salomoon bɨɨx bɨx dhi' gu kutun jix bhai'x ka't gu kutun; na gu' ka't vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki.
Gu' gu' gu Dabii ka't gu jodai' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n pai' ka't gu duukam; na gu' ka't gu chuukug vaak zel gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't gu ñi'ook gu Besaleel gu mar gu Uri gu mar gu ur ka't vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon bɨɨx mii' dhɨr gu kutun.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salomoon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai ka't vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut makgɨrxi bhaan jix bhai'x maa'nkar tai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu tukaa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' jix maa.
Ba' jix aa' gu Salomoon gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu kutun.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Dabii gu taat; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n na ja'p oo' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' matda' gu ja'tkam na ba' jix buus baakɨi vupui bhaan dhi' gu ja'tkam; na gu' chɨkka gu kutun gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon; na gu' dhi' ka't gu i'ii'ñ cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ namkɨm gu i'ii'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda' tu' gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'x gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na ba' tu' matda' gu ja'tkam na ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' matda' gu ja'tkam tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' gio tu' gu suudai' namkɨm gu i'ii'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' va'k tu' mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem jix bhai'x ka't gu kutun vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix bhai'x gu jodai' jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw gu takarui' vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' kavaayo bhiibgich gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto na ba' gu Salomoon; na gu' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' kavaayo bhiibgich.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu Ejipto gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai kavaayo gu ux chamaam mambhɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu chuukug gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu vaak mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu jodai' gu takarui' jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk vaik mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu bhóogɨt gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha'.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu chuukug gu Salomoon gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro; gio ba' gu vupui gu chuukug na ja'p gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak jix koi.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' vupui bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' tɨkiix na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu chuukug gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu vaak no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' gu suudai' jix gɨ'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' jix gɨ' bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' chɨkka ka't gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu vaak gu tɨkɨr cham jɨ'xdha' jugi; gio ba' chɨkka jix duñia' tu' gu chuukug gu vaak gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' jano' gu chio'ñ gu kutun gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai ñakaabma' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug bɨɨx gu chuukug gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu suudai' gu taat.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gio gu u'u gɨ' u'u kavɨk ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' tu duukam gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu u'u gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Na gu' na ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u na gu' gu vaak no'ñ gu chuukug tu' gu suudai' jix gɨ' jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ba' gu jodai' tu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'u jix maa gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug tiriik kai'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu chuukug kai' vaas gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu bhóogɨt bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu iram gu gɨ'kora' gu Tiro jix aa' gu ux gu bhóogɨt bhañ gu Salomoon; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' chɨtda gu iram; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix duu gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii gu mar jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak na ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ gu kutun gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu taat.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu u'vɨ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Dan gu' gu taat ka't gu Tiro; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu chuukug jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai gu jodai gu u'u ñakaabma' gu bhóogɨt gu ux; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' na ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu chuukug bɨɨx gu Jawatan gu Dabii gu taat.
Jano' ba' jano' jix duñia' gu Jawatan tu duukam tiriik kai' vaas bɨ'ñdhatu' suudai' u'va tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu u'u cham tu'x jai'ch gu chuukug tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ux gu gɨ' suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Joppe tu' jix duu gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Salomoon gu bhóogɨt gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' mi'p gu oidha' gu Israeel mi' dhɨr jix duñia' tu' jix duñia' gu Dabii gu taat jix bɨɨx duu bakia' chamaam mambhɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu vaak jix bhai'x na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu kavɨk vaik jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook daam na ba' duñia' gu chuukug gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' kua'da' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jerusalem gu kavɨk gu Moria ka't jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dabii gu taat pai' gu Dabii ka't gu duukam ka't gu Ornaan gu Jebuseo.
Jano' ba' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gook gu takarui' maakobh oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu chuukug gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu vaak jix duñia' chamaam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu ux gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu vaak jix gɨ' bɨɨx gu u'u ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix bhai' jix uam jodai gu suudai' bhaan gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio gu vaak gu jodai a'bhar gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix uam jodai ka't jix uam jodai gu Parbaim.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan dhaas gu vaak gu duukam gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar kiki'ñgob bɨɨx jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ux gu maa'nkar.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu vaak pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ux jix bhai'x gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas jix bhai' jix uam jodai gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt cha'tmam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix bhaan dhaas gio jix uam jodai gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gu suudai' duñia' a'aalh tu jiim jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu vaak; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu maa'nkar gu vaak; mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' ja'tkam gu suudai' mi'p gu takarui' gu ux gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' mi'p tɨɨt bɨɨx gu vupui bhaan gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt ñakaabma' gu ux gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu vupui bhaan gu vaak gook gu vaak gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu maa'nkar tu jiim jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar jix dhaas gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vaak vupui bhaan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu novɨ tu jiim o'nsop; gio ba' gu novɨ tu jiim jup tɨɨt gu Jakîn o'nsop gu Boas.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ' suudai' gu takarui' ga'ra' mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' xikoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨtaa'n ka't gu takarui' gu vaakax jix duñia' mambhɨɨx novɨ maa'nkar bɨx xikoolh; gio ba' jix duñia' gook gu bhóogɨt gu vaakax gu jodai' bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu gɨ' suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu kutun gu vaakax vaik jix duñia' gu jodai' vaik tas gei'ñ vaik saagi'ñ vaik tas buusñi; gio ba' gu gɨ' suudai' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx bhaan mi'p baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' jix duñia' gu novɨ jannulhi'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook jannulhi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu chuukug gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' vaik jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix duu gio mambhɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas jixchamaam tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop na ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan; gu' gu gɨ' suudai' ka't na ba' jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' mambhɨɨx daa'nkar tai na jix tas jix uam jodai bhaan duñia' jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Ademaas mambhɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' jix dhaas vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jixchamaam tu jiim jixchamaam o'nsop; gio ba' gu takarui' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu chuukug jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu i'ii'ñ gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ jix bhaan dhaas kiki'ñgob jix vɨgɨ jodai.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan tas buusñi gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gook gu vaak gu takarui' gu jodai' bhaan ɨɨbhidham gook gu vaak gook a'sak na ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' mi'p tu jiim gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu maa'nkar gook gu ñi'ook gook gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook gook gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' mi'p tu jiim gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ' suudai' gu kutun gu vaakax bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu taat gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' na jix uam gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt gu Jordaan gu oidha' u'u gat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Sukôt gu Seredat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ux jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook na gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gaagam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Salomoon bɨx gu ux na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai gu vaak na jix bhai' bhaan gu takarui' tɨkiix.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' daa'nkar tai na jix tas gu jodai' jix uam jodai na jix bhai' na ba' gu tai vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duu jix uam jodai gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' gio gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu jodai' ba'k gu vaak kiki'ñgob jix bhai'x na ba' pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kiki'ñgob gu vaak vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan jix uam jodai.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ka't bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon na ba' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Salomoon tu'x gu Dabii gu taat ka't gu takarui'; gio ba' jix dhaas jix toja jodai jix uam jodai bɨx gu ux gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem daraa gu Israeel bɨx chiñia' bopxi'ñ ɨɨbhidham gu jodai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' jix bhɨɨ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios kiicham gu Dabii gu Sioon.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia' gu takarui' kɨɨv.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs bɨx daraa gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu Lebitas kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu ux xidhuu mi'p vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas bhɨɨk.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' kakneer gu vaakax gu ux gu oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios pai' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai'.
Na gu' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ux tu jiim kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu vaak mai' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' ɨɨbhidham gu bhóogɨt kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' vupui bhaan gu bhóogɨt gu' cham jix duñia' dɨr mai'; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' cham ka't gu ñi'ook gook gu bhóogɨt gu Moisees ka't gu ñi'ook gu oreb bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix bhaan bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mi' dhɨr moor gu Ejipto.
Na gu' na ja'p jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan moor xidhuu na gu' bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham nukadham mui'kim.

Jano' ba' gu Lebitas gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu takarui' gu emaan gu Jedutuun bɨɨma'n bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam jajannulhi'ñ gu ux gu chuukug mi'p bɨɨx gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tas buusñi jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; gio ba' bɨɨx chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.

Jano' ba' gu mar gu ñi'ook alabaa'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; na gu' jix bhai' na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas; jano' ba' gu vaak jix bhuup jano' ba' toov gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ux kuiñcha toov; na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Salomoon; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu tukgam.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' tu' ba'bhak gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu vupui jix bhai' aa' bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel; gio ba' bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu takarui' ka't gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx gu novɨ tu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook gu ux gu chin gu Dabii gu taat bham.

Jano' ba' dɨr gu tanoolh gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu Ejipto matgɨm kiicham gu tasi' bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak pai' gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu tasi' gu chio'ñ jum duu gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' gu Jerusalem gu tasi' na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Dabii gu tasi' na ba' jum duu bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Dabii gu taat jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' dhi' gu i'ii'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' cham gu suudai' gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu mar gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' pai' gu Dabii gu taat gu bhóogɨt daakat atooxkor gu Israeel na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu Salomoon vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu noobh.

Na gu' na gu' gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu jodai' na jix uam jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jixchamaam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu ñi'ook vaik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix dhaas bhaan jix duñia' kɨkbok vupui bhaan bɨx gu takarui' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu noobh gu tɨkɨr jix aa'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios nɨidhim tu' gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oidha' nuuka'n ñi'ook na jix bhaan xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch tu duukam gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na nukadham tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu chin gu' bɨɨx gu novɨ jix duñia' na ja'p gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jano' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix nukadham tu duukam gu Dabii gu taat jix duñia' bham; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' gu chio'ñ vupui bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook atooxkor gu Israeel gu chuukug gu ma'nkam nukadham gu bhóogɨt jiim ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ja'p tu' vupui bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Dabii.
Gu' gu' tu'r gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix daa bɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu oidha' gu suudai' gu tɨkɨr cham jɨ'xdha' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu vaak gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt soi'm tu duukam soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug na ba' gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook soi'm bɨɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu vupui gu bhóogɨt bhaan dhi' gu vaak gu tanoolh gu tukaa' bhaan pai' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook; na gu bhóogɨt soi'm bɨɨx tu duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' pai'.
Na pai' dhuuk gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt soi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk dhi' pai' xoi'kam soi'm tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' jix koi; na gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' gu ñi'ook bhaan tɨtmo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu jodai' ñi'ook kavɨk aa' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt tu duukam jix maa gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bhaan mo'o gu ñi'ook jir bhai' jix maa jurtu'nka' bɨx bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix duñia' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan tu' dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ gu ja'tkam gu Israeel jix maat gu oidha' chɨɨdak tattat.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu tɨkɨr gu ñi'ook cham ka't dhuuk gu ux gu suudai' uañi'ñ bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' dhi' pai' gu jodai' gu tɨɨgɨ' jix duñia' uañi'ñ na pai' dhuuk gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr uañi'ñka' uañi'ñ tu duukam gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n dhuuk bhaan gu oidha' chɨɨdak gu ux gu maa'nkar gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' ka't bhiogi' gu oidha' tu' ka't gu ñi'ook tu' ka't gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu vaak; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' obhɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' gu vaak; mi' dhɨr no'x gu ux ko'kdai' ka't.
Jano' ba' bɨx soi'm bɨx soi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Israeel no'x gu takarui' tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ tu' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu noobh dhi' gu vaak.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' ba'bhak uañi'ñka' maa'n jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt dhaibu gu tasi' gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' gu duukam tu' jix maati' gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ; mi' dhɨr.
Na ba' na ba' tu' gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu tanoolh gu chuukug bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' gio ja'tkam mii' dhɨr cham ka't gu ja'tkam gu Israeel ka't tɨbiap gu jodai' oi'ñga'n kuiñcha jix gɨ' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu novɨ jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' jix koi jix duu jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu ñi'ook ka't duuñ tu' ja'tkam mii' dhɨr; na ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu suudai' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' gu takarui' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai' bhaan dhi' gu vaak gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' bhaan dhi' kiicham tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr soi'm soi'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug bhaan kapbhai' vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' obhɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' mia'n.

Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu oidha' pai' ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' tu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x pai' gu oi'ñga'n baabuk gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bhaan gu oidha' tu' chɨɨdak tattat bhaan kiicham gu jodai' bhaan gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dɨr gu tɨkɨr dɨr pai' jix koi soi'm soi'ñ gu ñi'ook kuiñcha uañi'ñka' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu suudai' maatɨt soi'm dhi' pai'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bamii' jano' na ba' gu ñi'ook jɨɨpi'ñka' tu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jajannulhi'ñ tulhiiñdha' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug xoi'kam jɨɨgi'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu takarui' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu Dabii tu duukam.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Salomoon jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n gu tai jix dhaav gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu suudai'; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vaak.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook baakɨi jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix dhaav gu tai gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak ia'rɨ gu oidha' bhaan gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ o'lhia tɨtdada' gu Jawatan Dios bham; na jix bhai' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu vaak na jix bhai' gu suudai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x gu vaakax chamaam gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x kakneer; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' bɨx gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu chuukug gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Lebitas bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas; na pai' dhuuk gu Dabii gu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ; jano' ba' gu suudai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan bɨx gu Israeel ka't tɨɨt.

Na gu' gio jix bhaan duu gu Salomoon tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ ka't vupui bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na gu' ka't gu suudai' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu jodai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix vɨgɨ jodai gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'nkar tai bhaan gu o'o gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu Salomoon gu takarui' kɨɨv gu tanoolh bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel jix gɨ' gu takarui' dɨr ba'k gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm gu jodai' gu Ejipto.
Na gu' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh jix duu gu ñi'ook na gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ux kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' kɨɨv bhañ gu ja'tkam dhi' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ gu ux gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Salomoon gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu Salomoon jix duñia' aagak duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa' jix ñi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Salomoon gu tukaa'; gio ba' tu' naak soi'm gu tasi' na ba' tu' dhi' pai' gu ux gu vaak gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu tɨkɨr cham ka't dhuuk tu' jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bhaan tu' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu vupui jix duñia' tomaat gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jano' ba' tu' tu jiim dɨr gu tɨkɨr gu bhóogɨt uañi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jano' no'm gu bhóogɨt gu vupui gu suudai' maatɨt soi'm dhi' pai'.
Na gu' jano' gu tasi' gu takarui' dhi' gu vaak na ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas; gio ba' gu vupui gu i'ii'ñ no'm gu oi'ñga'n na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' tu' jiim vupui bhaan tu' na ja'p jix jiim gu Dabii gu taat gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x tu' jix aa'ñdhix nukadham ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Yo gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim atooxkor oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' na ja'p gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Dabii gu taat bham; gio ba' cham jix duñia' gu chio'ñ tu' gu chuukug gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' tu' gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x mi'x dhaas ñi'ook kavɨk jix duñia' ka't gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix maa; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu takarui' gu tɨɨgɨ' tu' mi'x juu'ñ vupui bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu vaak gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' dhi' gu vaak.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tattat jix buusñi gu oidha' gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ o'lhia jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu jodai' bɨx dhi' cham bhai' bhaan.
Jano' ba' ka't gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu Salomoon jɨ'dɨlh gu iram ka't jix maa dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu Salomoon gu Amat gu Soba jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Tadmor oidha' jix gaki bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook pai'x gu amat.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Bet-oron jiix gu Bet-oron gu i'ii'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' gu Baalat bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon ga'ra'; gio ba' gio bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu Salomoon gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bɨx gu oidha' aapi'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam ka't jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Amorreos gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jebuseos cham jix duñia' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu suudai' jix duñia' gu oidha' mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu chuukug bɨx gu Salomoon bopxi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham jix dhaas gu Salomoon tu duukam gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chiñia' gu ñi'ook jugi gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu Salomoon gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' jix aa'ñdhix mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Salomoon mar u'vɨ gu Faraoon kiicham gu Dabii gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix aa'; na gu' gu u'vɨ cham jix koi gu vaak gu Dabii gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na gu' mii' dhɨr jix daa pai' tu' kia'mi'ñ kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' makgɨrxi gu Salomoon maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu i'ii'ñ.

Na ba' na ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Moisees tas na jix bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook vaik mui'kim oi'ñga' maachim gu takarui' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu chuukug gu takarui' gu kutun.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu jodai' jurtu'nka' gu vaak gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu Lebitas gu duukam gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' vupui bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu duukam gu vaak ki'ñgob; na gu' ka't jix aa'ñdhix gu Dabii gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' cham moor gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas gu takarui' bɨx gu chuukug.
Na gu' na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook dɨr gu tanoolh gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Salomoon ka't gu Esion-geber gu Elot gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu oidha' gu Edom.

Na gu' na gu' gu iram ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' gu gɨ' suudai' jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx tu duukam gu Salomoon gu Opir jix bhɨɨ gu oi'ñga'n mambhɨɨx cha'tmam jix uam jodai aichdhak gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.

Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu suudai' gu Seba gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Salomoon suudai' u'va gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx jix ai gu ñi'ook gu duukam jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook gu jodai a'bhar na ba' vaak zel gu Salomoon bɨɨx tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Salomoon tu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ga'ra'.
Gu' gu' gu Salomoon gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Salomoon cham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu suudai' gu Seba matda' gu Salomoon gu vaak ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' koi' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu duukam dhi' gu suudai' jajannulhi'ñ gu takarui' jajannulhi'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux pai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' tu'r ka't naak gu oidha' tu'x matda'.

Gu' gu' tu' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm tɨbiap gu vupui jix duñia' buupui; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu duukam matda' ka't jix duñia' tu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' daam gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' ka't naak.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu chichio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam tu duukam bɨɨx tas vupui bhaan tu' gu suudai' matda'.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu takarui' tu' jix duñia' tu' na ba' gu takarui' bhaan atooxkor gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Israeel na ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhai'x gu ux gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan na ba' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨx bhai'.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu gɨ'kora' chamaam gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gu jodai a'bhar; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk ka't gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt na ja'p jix maa gu suudai' gu Seba gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' gio tu duukam gu iram tu duukam gu Salomoon gu suudai' gu jodai' jix uam jodai gu Opir aichdhak gu u'u gu ñi'ook gu jodai a'bhar.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu gɨ'kora' gu u'u gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oidha' gu Judaa ka't buupui gu u'u nɨidhim.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix maa gu suudai' gu Seba bɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ka't gu oidha' bɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu jodai' gu Salomoon oi'ñga' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Arabia chiñia' gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix uam jodai gu ñi'ook maa'n ga'ra' gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai tu juan.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' vaik gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai gu suudai' da'p gu ñi'ook vaik gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai; gio ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' atooxkor gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ atooxkor bɨɨx dhaibu' jix uam jodai gu bhóogɨt baasɨ'n pai' gu ñi'ook gook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mi'p ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' ka't gio gu kutun gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n; gio ba' mɨɨjidha' ka't gu ñi'ook nɨidhim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oi'ñdha'.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon ka't jix uam jodai bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu ux gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu tanoolh gu Salomoon jix toja jodai cham ka't jix duñia'.

Na gu' na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu Tarsis bɨɨx tu duukam gu iram vaik gu takarui' gu tas jix ai gu takarui' gu Tarsis gu bhóogɨt jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu jodai' gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' gu maa'nkar matda'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu oidha' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vupui gu Salomoon gu ux gu bhóogɨt matda' gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' suulhgia' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu o'o gu ux jix toja jodai gu ux jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt kavaayo gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Salomoon maakobh jix bhai'x kavaayo na ba' kavaayo gu bhóogɨt gu kutun jix bhai'x gu jodai' jix dhaas jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' aapi' bhaan bɨx gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gɨ' suudai' jiim bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha' gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' jix toja jodai gu Jerusalem na ja'p gu jodai gɨ' u'u kavɨk na ja'p chiiw gu takarui' gu ux vaak ja'tkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio kavaayo na ba' gu Salomoon gu Ejipto bɨx oidha' gɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Salomoon dharka' gu bhóogɨt cham bɨx ua'nak gu oi'ñga'n gu Nataan jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Aiias gu Silonita gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu Iddo bhaan gu Jeroboam gu mar gu Nabat.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon gu Jerusalem bhaan bɨx gu Israeel oo'm gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Salomoon bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook kiicham gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Roboam gu mar.
Na gu' gu Roboam ka't gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Israeel na ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' ka't gu Ejipto pai' ka't jix duñia' kuiñcha gu gɨ'kora' gu Salomoon jix duñia' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' mɨjɨ tɨɨt; gio ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Roboam bham.
Jano' ba' gu taat jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' gu tasi'; gio ba' gu takarui' tu' jano' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' juantu'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tasi' bɨɨx gu taat jix duñia' tu' gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' vaik gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam ka't.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx kɨklhi'ñga'n gu suudai' dhi' vupui bhaan gu Salomoon gu taat na pai' dhuuk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu takarui' bɨɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' tu ñi'ook jix bhai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix maa kɨklhi'ñga'n jix bhɨɨ gu kutun bɨɨx biipibop gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨɨx vupui bhaan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu takarui' tu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' bham; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu taat jix dhaas bhaan no'ch.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' biipibop a'ga jix duñia' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' daipu' gu ja'tkam tu' tu ñi'ook bham gu taat jix duñia' chulhiiñdha' gu tasi' gu' tu' gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr daipu'; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu taat.
Na ba' gu taat gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu tasi' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; gio ba' gu taat jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chuukug tu' bɨɨx gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Jeroboam bɨɨx bɨx gu ja'tkam gu Roboam vaik gu tanoolh; gio ba' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' ka't jix aa'ñdhix bham; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x tu' vaik gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' jix bhai'x; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu kutun kɨklhi'ñga'n.
Ba' jix aa' jurtu'nka' gu kutun biipibop bham; gio ba' gu taat jix duñia' gu tasi' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr gu taat jix duñia' bɨɨx gu chuukug tu' bɨɨx gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam; na gu' kuiñcha ka't gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ka't tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook gu Aiias gu Silonita gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't naak jix aa' gu ja'tkam gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n tañia' no'ch bɨɨx gu Dabii tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu mar gu Isaii gu Israeel maa'n dhi' gu Dabii gu suudai' jano' gu ux gu vaak ka't bɨx gu Israeel dhi'.
Gu' gu' jix gɨ'kora' gu Roboam bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oi'ñka' jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu Adoram ga'ra' gu chuukug bopxi'ñ; gu' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix koi; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel gu vaak gu Dabii bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p suudai' u'va gu Roboam gu Jerusalem jum daa'ñ gu vaak gu Judaa gu Benjamiin chamaam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu ux bhaan gu Israeel gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Roboam.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Israelitas gu Judaa gu Benjamiin.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham jix tɨ'ɨ tu' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu ja'tkam; na gu' gu jodai' maa'n gu vaak na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu chuukug; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' cham jix bɨɨx duu bhaan gu Jeroboam.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix daa gu Roboam gu Jerusalem jɨ'dɨlh na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Bet-leem gu Etam gu Tekoa.
Jano' ba' gu Bet-sur gu Sokô gu Adullam.
Jano' ba' gu Gat gu Maresa gu Sip.
Jano' ba' gu Adoraim gu Lakîs gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu Sora gu ñi'ook gu ebroon jix duñia' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu bhóogɨt jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu takarui' suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh kutun kavɨk gu suudai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin mi'p gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Lebitas mi'p bɨx gu Israeel jum daa'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu ñi'ook aajidha' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; na gu' gu Jeroboam maraa'n gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' i'ii'mda' na ba' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gio bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon gu ux vaik gu takarui'; na gu' vaik gu takarui' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu Salomoon.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Roboam gu ux gu u'vɨ gu Maalat mar u'vɨ gu Jerimot gu mar gu Dabii gu Abiail mar u'vɨ gu Eliab gu mar gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu Jeus gu Samaria gu Saam.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Absalom jix duñia' gu Abiiyas gu Atai gu Sisa gu Selomit.
Gu' gu' gu Roboam jix duñia' gu Maakâ mar u'vɨ gu Absalom bhaan bɨx gu u'vɨ; na gu' jix bhɨɨ mambhɨɨx gu tasi' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix mar gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Na gu' jix dhaas gu Roboam gu Abiiyas gu mar gu Maakâ gu ux mo'o gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨx gu ma'nkam gu ux bɨx oi'ñga'n gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu ux bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk jix maa gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mumua'da' gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Roboam ka't tu jiim oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel.
Na gu' jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto bhaan gu Jerusalem na gu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ kavaayo; gu' gu ja'tkam gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Ejipto cham ga'ra' jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; mi' dhɨr maachim gu maa'nkar gu Sukienos gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Semeiias gu Roboam chiñia' gu Judaa mi'p gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem gu ux kuiñcha gu Sisak; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim tu' gio tɨtda:―Cha'pim gu noobh gu Sisak.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gui'p; gio ba' jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' jix duñia' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Semeiias bham; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' va'k dodhia' gu chuukug cham jix duñia' gu vaak bhaan gu Jerusalem gu ux gu novɨ gu Sisak.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook ka't tu duukam; na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sisak gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto gu Jerusalem jix bhɨɨ gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a jix uam jodai gu Salomoon ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu pai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Roboam gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu jodai' na jix uam do'ñcho gu noobh gu takarui' nukadham jix duñia' ba'k gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios aajidha' nukadham gu bhóogɨt mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim nukadham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' daak gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix na ba' cham cham tu' duu bɨx; gio ba' gio gu Judaa tu'x jix bɨɨx duu xoi'kam.

Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu Roboam jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem; na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Roboam oo'm gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem kiicham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel na ba' jix dhaas gu tɨɨgɨ'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Naama gu Ammonita.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' na gu' cham jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ na ba' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu'x gu Roboam tumiiñku gu bhóogɨt cham ua'ñix gu oi'ñga'n gu Semeiias jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Iddo gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Roboam gu Jeroboam ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Roboam bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Abiiyas gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jeroboam jix gɨ'kora' gu Abiiyas bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' vaik gu takarui' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Mikâiia mar u'vɨ gu Uriel gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Abiiyas gu Jeroboam.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu vaak gu Abiiyas gu chuukug bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' gu Jeroboam gu vaak gu chuukug bhaan bɨɨx gu chuukug jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix kavɨk gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu Abiiyas bhaan gu kavɨk gu Semaraim gu kakkavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix maa oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Dabii bhaan gu Israeel na ba' bɨɨx tas gu ma'nkam ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' tu duukam gu Salomoon gu mar gu Dabii jix búup gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan.
Na gu' jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' gu ma'nkam tu' na cham jir bhai' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu Roboam gu mar gu Salomoon na gu' gu Roboam ka't gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu i'ii'ñ cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jano' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Dabii na gu' mui'x namki' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai gu Jeroboam gu ux gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' cham mi'x juu'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ja'tkam oi'ñga'n na ba' no'x gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tuur kɨɨv gu chuukug ka't jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham gu Jawatan Dios.

Gu' gu' gu jodai' no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu jodai' tɨtda:―Cha'pim; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu xibh gu xumai gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' na jix bhai' mɨichdhai jix uam jodai bɨɨx gu jodai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xumai; na gu' no'ch nukadham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' tɨtda:―Cha'pim.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx no'ch gu ux mo'o jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu oi'ñga'n bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tattat na gu' cham gu chuukug xoi'kam.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' gu Jeroboam gu jodai' gu ja'tkam na ba' jix ai gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kua' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu Judaa gu suudai' ga'ra' gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ux tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jeroboam bɨx gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Abiiyas gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jiboi'ññor gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Judaa gu takarui' do'ñcho gu noobh.
Jano' ba' gu Abiiyas gu ja'tkam gu chuukug jix koi; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu jodai' gu Israeel gu takarui' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa jix duñia' na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Abiiyas gu Jeroboam jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh gu Bet-el bɨɨx taañpu' gu Jesana bɨɨx taañpu' gu Epraim bɨɨx taañpu'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu Jeroboam gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu Abiiyas; gio ba' naaka'n gu Jawatan Dios jix koi.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Abiiyas; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix mar gu oi'ñga'n gu ma'nkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Abiiyas gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' ua'nak gu tasi' gu Iddo jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Abiiyas bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu mar gu Asa gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ux mambhɨɨx gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Asa jix bhai' jix duñia' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu duukam gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug jix duñia' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Judaa gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tattat jaisaidhat gu ux tu duukam ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug juruuñ oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu suudai' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa na gu' ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu oidha' cham ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ux gu jodai' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' jɨ'dɨlh gu suudai' vaak jodai bɨɨx gɨ' vaak kiki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oidha' gu kutun; na gu' gu jodai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim tu' jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' jix duñia' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gio gu Asa ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook kutun kavɨk u'u kavɨk; gio ba' gu Judaa vaik jix bhai'x gu Benjamiin gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu bhóogɨt kutun kavɨk jix duñia' u'u gat; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix buus bhaan gu Sera gu kutun bɨɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mambhɨɨx gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n vaik gu ñi'ook; gio ba' suudai' u'va bɨɨx ka'm gu Maresa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buus gu Asa bhaan gu vaak gu chuukug gu suudai' gu Sepata ju'ñdharan gu Maresa.

Ba' jix aa' tu ñi'ook gu Asa gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx jix gɨ' bɨɨx matgɨm gu kavɨk juraa'n na ba' gu chuukug u'ua'tɨdham; na gu' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' na gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu bhóogɨt bhaan dhi' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu chuukug chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu takarui' bhaan tu' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan gu Asa vupui bhaan gu Judaa; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' gu Asa gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka't chɨ'ɨɨk bɨɨx ka'm gu Gerar; gio ba' ia'rɨ gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ; na gu' jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu takarui'.
Na gu' jix duñia' gio gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh gu Gerar na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan; na gu' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh na gu' ka't gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix maa bhaan gu suudai' aichdhak mumua'da' kakneer jix ai suulh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Asariias gu mar gu Obed.

Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Asa; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Asa bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook ka't bɨɨx; jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' ka't gaagam gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' mi'x dhaas gio kiicha'.
Jano' ba' mui'x gu tanoolh tu' dhi' gu Israeel cham jir bɨx bhai' gu Jawatan Dios cham jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan cham gu ux cham ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk chulhiiñ jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu ñi'ook ka't gaagam.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu ñi'ook cham ka't bhai'x i'ii'ñ tu' na ba' jix duñia' tu' na ba' busaak gu ñi'ook mumua'da' tulhiiñ bhaan bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook kiicham; na gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui' cham gu chuukug gu noobh; na gu bhóogɨt cham tu'x jai'ch na ba' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Asa gu ñi'ook ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Obed jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oidha' gu Judaa gu Benjamiin jɨ'dɨlh ka't jix bhɨɨ gu kavɨk gu Epraim; gio ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios ka't vupui bhaan gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Epraim gu Manasees gu Simeoon; na gu' mui'x gu Israeel gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñɨi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Jerusalem gu takarui' vaik oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu vaakax kɨɨv jix bhai'x kakneer.
Jano' ba' baap gu maa'nkar tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios tattat bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' no'x cham tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel vaak jodai jix gɨ' jix ali' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu Judaa jix duñia'; na gu' bɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook bɨx aagak gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't gaagam; jano' ba' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios jɨɨpi'ñka' bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Na gu' gu suudai' gu Maakâ gu naan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ux; gio ba' gu Asa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bhi'ñbak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Gu' gu' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ux gu i'ii'ñ gu Asa ka't gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jix oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vaak gu takarui' gu taat ka't gu takarui' ka't jix bhaan jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu ux.
Jano' ba' cham ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa.

Jano' ba' jix duu oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa jix tɨ'ɨ gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhaan gu Judaa gu Rama na ba' cham mi'x dhaas jix buus tu' baakɨi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Asa jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu vaak vaak ja'tkam bhañ gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't gu Damasko bham.

Jano' ba' ka't ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na ja'p ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai na ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu Baasa gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu suudai' tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Ben-adad bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa bhañ gu ñi'ook chugi'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Dan gu Abel-maim jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ dhi' gu Baasa jix utu'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Rama mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asa jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu Judaa bhɨɨk gu Rama gu jodai gu u'u bɨɨx gu Baasa gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu chuukug gu Mispa.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook suudai' u'va gu anani gu ñi'ook gu Asa gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na gu' tu' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook cham tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu noobh.
Na gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Libios cham jix duñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam kavaayo bɨɨx bɨx na gu' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios do'ñcho gu noobh.

Na gu' na gu' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu oidha' na ba' gu ñi'ook namki' gu i'ii'ñ gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx; gio ba' jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook dhi'; na gu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan tu'.
Na gu' jix bhai'x gu Asa bhaan gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ gu vaak kuupa' na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuiñcha dhi'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Asa mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhɨt gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Asa dharka' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu Asa tɨɨt na ba' jiix ko'kdai' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Asa bɨɨx tattat jix koi oi'ñga' oo'm maa'n gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook pai'm ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix dhaas gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu kutun ɇɇka' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu ñi'ook gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix duu gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu ñi'ook gu mar jix duñia' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu takarui' gu oidha' gu Judaa gu suudai' jɨ'dɨlh gu Epraim gu taat gu Asa ka't jix bhɨɨ.
Na gu' ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook na gu' jix jiim dharka' gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham jix duñia' gu Baales.
Gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu taat jix jiim gu ñi'ook cham bhaan buimɨi gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu jodai' jix duñia' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu novɨ bɨx gu Judaa jix maa gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' jix duñia' namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' vaik oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ chiñia' gu Ben-ail gu Obdiias gu takarui' gu chuukug gu Mikêas na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu Lebitas gu Semeiias gu Netaniias gu Sebadiias gu Asael gu Semiramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Adoniias gu Tobiias gu Tobadoniias gu Lebitas; gio ba' bɨɨx gu Elisama gu Joram jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Judaa da'p baidhak u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ux bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' oi'ñga'n mi'p xikoolh gu Judaa; na cham gu suudai' gu chuukug bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Pilisteos gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ jix toja jodai; gio ba' gu Arabes gio aichdhak gu suudai' kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu chuukug kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu chuukug gu ñi'ook chiiw.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix bhai'x; gio ba' pai'x gu Judaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' mumua'da' buimɨi jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' dhi' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' bhaan gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu Judaa gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Adna bɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu kutun bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ux gu Amasiias gu mar gu Sikri ka't gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu Eliada gu chio'ñ gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu ux gu takarui' bɨɨx chamaam jix bhai'x gu suudai' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' gu ux bɨx gu Judea.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu ñi'ook namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhɨt gu takarui' jix dhaav gu suudai' gu Samaria; gio ba' gu ux jix duñia' gu suudai' mumua'da' kakneer gu vaakax na ba' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jum duu bɨɨx gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu chuukug gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr na ja'p tu' gio tu'; jano' ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam gio gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' bɨndak bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jum daa'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu takarui' bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' tu' gu suudai' gui'p; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu takarui' kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu kutun jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ux tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu suudai' cham tu'x jai'ch gu chio'ñ gu ux gu takarui' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu' tu' gu bhóogɨt na gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tas cham bhai'; jano' ba' dhi' gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla; gio ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jup tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu vupui gu kutun gu Mikêas gu mar gu Imla.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa mi'p gu bhóogɨt maa'n atooxkor jajannulhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' mi'p gu bhóogɨt ka't ba'k ki'ñgob gu Samaria bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan jix duñia' vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu bhóogɨt ka't gu ñi'ook a'aa' jix kavɨk jodai chɨtda; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm cham tu' duu bɨx.
Jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gio bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan bham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' mattuda' ka't gu ja'tkam tɨɨt gu Mikêas bham; gio ba' gu Miren gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu chin jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't na ja'p maa'n tu ñi'ook xoi'kam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora'.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu Mikêas gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' tu' gu suudai' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ ka't gu ñi'ook ka't kapbhai' gu noobh.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mui'kim tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu'r.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' buupui bɨx gu Israeel vaak na jix bhaan gu ux gu kakkavɨk na ja'p kakneer cham bipia'dam; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam cham namki' gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu jodai' maa'n bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham tu' ka't tu' tu ñi'ook cham gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' buupui gu Jawatan Dios daakat atooxkor bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr ka't gu novɨ tu jiim o'nsop.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' chɨkka gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix duñia' gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n chɨtda.
Ba' jix aa' gu' jix buus gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ jix dhaas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix buus tu jiim.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook gu chin dhi' ja'tkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu suudai' cham bhai' gu ñi'ook tu'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Sedekîas gu mar gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' naaka'n gu Mikêas gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt jix ai'chdhix tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu Mikêas jix aa'; na pai' dhuuk gu Miren tu' gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh na pai' dhuuk tu' ba'k gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Mikêas gu ñi'ook gu Amoon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham gu Joas gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ux kuupa' gu suudai' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu jodai' gu suudai' gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm tu' jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Mikêas; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' tu ñi'ook gu ux tu'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam bɨx.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' na ba' baakɨi gu chuukug; gu' tu' gu suudai' jajannulhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel chɨbiapui gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix aa'ñdhix gu ñi'ook ga'ra' baidhak bham; gio ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bɨɨx jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gui'p; gio ba' dhi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' na ba' gu ux; gu' gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook u'ua'tɨdham gu Jawatan Dios jix ai'chdhix gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n.

Gu' gu' gu suudai' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt naaka'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu kutun gu chuukug; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu takarui' yooxi' na gu' dhi' cham bhai' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh gu ux juruuñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tɨɨt gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gu' jix koi gu oi'ñga'n gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix duñia' bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu vaak gu Jerusalem.

Ba' jix aa' jix buus gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jeuu gu ñi'ook gu mar gu anani gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug u'ua'tɨdham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios daak gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan tu' gu ux gu i'ii'ñ.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gaagam tu' jix bhai' tu'x na gu' gu takarui' gu oidha' gu jodai' gu i'ii'ñ gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem; gu' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n busaak gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Beer-seba bɨɨx ka'm gu kavɨk gu Epraim gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas gu oidha' gu bhóogɨt bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa gu ux bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu suudai' xoi'kam; na gu' cham gu bhóogɨt pai' gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook pai' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug ñi'ook na jir bhai'.

Jano' ba' ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook choo'n gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' nukadham xoi'kam; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' na cham jir bhai' tu' gu duukam gu bhóogɨt tu' gu takarui' gu oi'ñga'n.

Jano' ba' jix dhaas gio gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem dhɨt gu Lebitas jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan tattat gu jodai' gu Israeel na ba' ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu chuukug; gio ba' suulh gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' gu takarui' gu suudai' bɨɨx choo'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx tu'r bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨx bhai'.

Na gu' gu chuukug kuiñcha gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ɨ'ɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu chuukug ñi'ook kavɨk gu suudai' jix duñia' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham gu oi'ñga'n daak bhaan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Amariias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Sebadiias gu mar gu Ismael gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak gu Judaa bɨx gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr gio gu Lebitas ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; na gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu'x ka't gu ma'nkam gu Moab gu Ammoon bɨɨx gu Ammonitas tɨɨtɨs bhaan gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jix maa aa'ñdham gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' bhaan tu' jupaabkamu'n jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n baasɨ'n gu gɨ' suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu asasoon-tamar gu Engedi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' choo'n; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu suudai' gu maa'nkar bɨx gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu Judaa na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gio bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Judaa tɨɨtɨs gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu masad gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu i'ii'ñ jix vɨɨk.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios taata'n tattat cham gu chuukug tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨkɨr tu' gu takarui' bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' chɨbɨɨp cham gu novɨ jix duñia' gu kavɨk bɨxchu'x cham cham tu'x jai'ch tu' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' cham mi'x juu'ñ tu' jix koi gu chuukug gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Israeel chɨɨdak gu kai' gu Abraam gu ja'tkam na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu chuukug tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook xidhuu gu tɨɨgɨ' bham.

Na gu' tu' cham bhai' gu oi'ñga'n bhaan no'ch gu kuchii sɨlhka'n gu ñi'ook bhiogi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan dhi' gu vaak vupui bhaan tu' na gu' gu tɨɨgɨ' dhi' gu vaak bopxi'ñ duuñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ u'ua'tɨda'.

Na pai' dhuuk jano' gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Seir gu oidha' cham gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Israeel na pai' dhuuk aajidha' gu oidha' gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Dan gu kutun bai'ñpu' mi'x juu'ñ gu maa'nkar tu' chɨɨdak gu ñi'ook.

Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' cham gu bhóogɨt tu' na gu' no'ch cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu kavɨk bhaan gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n jupaabkamu'n bhaan no'ch; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu vupui gu' tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Dios gu vupui.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Judaa ka't tɨɨt vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam.

Jano' ba' ka't gu Jaasiel gu mar gu takarui' gu mar gu Benaiias gu mar gu Jeiel gu mar gu Mataniias gu Lebita gu ma'nkam gu Asap bhaan suudai' u'va gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu masad.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa bɨx gu ñi'ook jix koi gu Jerusalem tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' cham gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' vupui bhaan dhi' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' cham bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu xibh jix dhaav bhaan; gio ba' gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu takarui' gu Sis gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu jodai' va'k oidha' jix gaki gu Jeruel.

Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' na ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' tulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem cham gu takarui' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu xibh bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vupui gu ux gu oidha' gu suudai' bɨx gu Judaa jix koi gu Jerusalem jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios o'lhia gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu ma'nkam gu Koree na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix gɨ' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix búup gu ux gu xibh moor gu ux oidha' jix gaki gu Tekoa; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix buus gu ñi'ook kua' tɨɨt jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa jix koi gu Jerusalem; jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ja'tkam jix dhaas dhɨt gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt busaak gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook; na gu' tas na jix gɨ' gu Jawatan Dios na gu' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' na ja'p kua'da' bɨɨx tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu kutun jix dhaas gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab gu kavɨk gu Seir gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ aajidha' bhaan gu Judaa jix duñia'.
Na gu' gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon gu Moab jix búup bhaan gu kavɨk gu Seir na ba' kooda' cham tu' duu; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu Seir u'ua'tɨdham chajaañ duiñchu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Judaa gu oi'ñga'n oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n; gu' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu oidha' koko'kam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' bai'ñpu' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mumua'da' namkɨm tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jajannulhi'ñ na ja'p gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ na ba' gu bhóogɨt cham gu suudai'; na gu' vaik gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu takarui' na gu' ka't jix jai'.
Jano' ba' maakobh gu tanoolh jum daa'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Beraka; na gu' jix bhai' aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux dhi' tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Beraka bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook mo'o suulh na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa gu bhóogɨt obhɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios bhaan bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' mii' dhɨr gu oidha' na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu jodai' bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jɨɨpi'ñka'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios jix maa jɨɨpi'ñka' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu Judaa; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu takarui' ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam gu takarui' gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Asuba mar u'vɨ gu Sili.
Jano' ba' jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Asa gu taat cham gu ñi'ook duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; na gu ja'tkam gu suudai' cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n gu i'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook dharka' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jeuu gu mar gu anani gu kutun gu ñi'ook u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu'x gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't jix maa gu ux.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx chu'p na ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' bhaai'n gu Tarsis; gio ba' gu suudai' gu takarui' gu Esion-geber.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Elieser gu mar gu Dodaba gu Mareosa jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook bham; na gu' gu ñi'ook chu'p bɨɨx gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt buimɨi; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' jix duñia' cham jix duñia' tu' gu Tarsis.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joram gu mar.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' boosgi tu'x gu jodai' jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix maa gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu Lebita gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu Simi xibhɨk ka't gook.
