Jano' ba' gu Koree gu mar gu Imna gu Lebita gu duukam tas buusñi ga'ra' gu chuukug saba'da' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix maa gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' bɨx jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu novɨ ka't gu Edeen gu Benjamiin gu Jesua gu Semaiias gu Amariias gu Sekâniias jɨ'dɨlh jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan na ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' na ja'p jix ali'.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu chichio'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaik gu takarui' jiix bɨx jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu ux gu takarui' bhaan gu jodai' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu ux gu jodai' tattat gu Lebitas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jiix jurtu'nka' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx bɨx a'aalh gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨx ja'tkam vaak; na gu' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tu'x jix bhaan.

Jano' ba' gu vaak gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan mi'p gu jodai' jɨ'dɨlh gu ux bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu chichio'ñ gu suudai' ko'kmarak gu chuukug gu jodai' bɨx gu chichio'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu Esekîas bɨx gu Judaa; gio ba' jix duñia' jix bhai' gu ñi'ook jir bɨx bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu jodai' kua'da' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' tu'x dhi' gu oi'ñga'n suudai' u'va gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios chɨbiapui gu Judaa jix duñia' yooxi' bhaan jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk jix duñia' baakɨi.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu Esekîas namkia' gu Sennakêrib gu ñi'ook jugi gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx chiñia' bɨɨx gu chuukug bhaan gu bhóogɨt suudai' buusñi gu suudai' mi'p mai' kiicham; gio ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ jix jai' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' bɨx suudai' buusñi gu jodai' biiñ gu ux tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria mumua'da' gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' gu Esekîas bɨx gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux mai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ux kiicham gu Dabii jix duu mumua'da' u'uux gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a.
Ba' jix aa' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu ja'tkam jix duu gu jodai' ɨrban ki'ñgob kiicham gu i'ii'ñ bham.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug; gio ba' cham gu takarui' tu' gu oi'ñga'n ɨɨbhi'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu' bɨx gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx jupaabkamu'n; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx no'ch bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu' bɨɨx no'ch gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios na ba' u'ua'tɨdham gu ux gu Dios gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios kua' bhaan gu Lakîs bɨɨx bɨx bɨxchu'x bhañ tu duukam gu Jerusalem na ba' a'ga gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bɨx gu Judaa mi'p gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios; gio ba' chɨkka gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu takarui' na ba' gu chuukug mia'n gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' cham gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas na ba' kɨɨsa' koi'm bhiogi' gu chuukug bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Ba' jix aa' cham gu Esekîas tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; gio ba' vupui bhaan dhi' gu duukam jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' bhaan jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham jix duñia' gu jodai' tu' tattat gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oidha' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨx gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr chɨbɨɨp gu chuukug tattat gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu noobh gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu kutun gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu novɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas tu' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu oi'ñga'n; na tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu noobh tattat gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu kutun jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' tu'x tu ñi'ook tu duukam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu duukam gu Esekîas.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' dhi' ua'na gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ua'rgidhimɨk bhaan bham; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp gu maa'nkar cham jix duñia' o'dam ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu noobh gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas o'dam ñi'ook gu kutun gu noobh.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu ja'tkam gu Jerusalem ka't gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' choo'n na ba' gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem na ja'p bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu chichio'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos jix duñia' gu ux dhi' tu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ nobii'ñ naaka'n bɨx jix kavɨk gu takarui' gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ux gu jodai' bɨɨx xi'ɨraam gu vupui gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr baakɨk vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ba'k.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Esekîas jix koi gu Jerusalem gu noobh gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu noobh bɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' mui'x aichdhak gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Jerusalem gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa chutumñigam juana'; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' vupui bhaan bɨx chɨbɨɨp mi' dhɨr dhi'.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas jix duñia' koi'm; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' jix maa nɨi'ñchudat.
Gu' gu' gu Esekîas cham jix duñia' jurtu'nka' xoi'kam ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ ka't daak bhaan gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu chuukug gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' jix koi gu Jerusalem; gio ba' cham suudai' u'va bhaan gu ñi'ook daak gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh gu Esekîas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Esekîas namkɨm gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duu gu takarui' jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu jodai a'bhar gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu oi'ñga'n kai'ñ suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' dhi' na ba' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaakax gu takarui' na ba' gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jɨ'dɨlh gu takarui' kakneer gu jodai' gu vaak; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu Esekîas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Gioon jiix jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tas gei'ñ kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' ka't gu bhóogɨt gu Esekîas bɨx jix duu.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu chuukug chiñia' gu Babiloonia mɨjɨ na ba' maachim gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim ka't gu oi'ñga'n mii' dhɨr gu oidha' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug jix maati' bɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu suudai' bɨx ua'nak ñi'ook na jix aa'dham Jawatan gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos u'uan gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Esekîas bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook pai'm gu ma'nkam gu Dabii gu chuukug koi'm bɨx gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Manasees gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu kutun gu takarui' ka't gu Manasees na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx jixchamaam gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jurtu'nka' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp ka't baas gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu na gu' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Esekîas gu taat ka't gu o'o jix búup jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baales gu jodai' jix duñia' bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gio jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Jerusalem ka't gu tɨɨgɨ' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tɨkɨr gook gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ux gu tai gu suudai' gu ma'nkam gu innom; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix maa jix duñia' gu jodai' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ duñia' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu oi'ñga'n dhi' jix dhaas na jax chu'm gu takarui' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu Salomoon gu mar; gio ba' dhi' gu vaak gu Jerusalem tu' gu takarui' bhaan bɨx bopxi'ñ gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' na ba' bɨɨx tas.

Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' tɨɨt gu Israeel gu oidha' tu' kapbhai' tattat gu chuukug nukadham xoi'kam bɨx tu'x tu' jix aa'ñdhix bɨx ñi'ook na tu a'ga ñi'ook kavɨk gu oi'ñga'n gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Manasees gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Judaa jix koi gu Jerusalem na ba' duñia' gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' chɨbɨɨp gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Manasees gu ja'tkam gu' cham jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios jix bhɨɨ bhaan gu takarui' gu jodai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu gɨ'kora' jix duu jix duñia' bɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu suudai' bhɨɨk gu Babiloonia.
Gu' gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix bhai'x gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios tattat.
Jano' ba' dhaibu gu takarui' ka't gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix kai soi'm jix duñia' paaskua oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Manasees gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu mi' dhɨr dhi' vaak jodai gu tasi' kiicham gu Dabii tas gei'ñ gu ñi'ook gu suudai' ba'k ki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu ux gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios paaskua mi'x juu'ñ mai' kiicham.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan bhaan makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhai' ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Judaa gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu vaak na jix bhai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Manasees soi'm gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu jodai' tu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu suudai' bɨx ua'nak gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu soi'm gio gu ñi'ook ka't naak bɨx uañi'ñ gu chuukug gu ñi'ook pai' gu oi'ñga'n ka't gu ñi'ook gu jodai' duiñxim va'k gu chuukug gu suudai' dhi' tu'x ua'ñix gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Manasees bɨɨx tattat jix duñia' gu vaak; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Amoon gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gook gu takarui' ka't gu Amoon na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook gook gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' paaskua.

Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't gu ñi'ook gu Manasees gu taat; na gu' gu bhóogɨt duiñxim gu taat gu Manasees ka't gu ñi'ook maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan jix duñia' gu Amoon.
Gu' gu' cham pai' dhuuk jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix duñia' gu Manasees gu taat; gio ba' va'k jix duñia' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan tu duukam jix duñia' gu vaak.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu jodai' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix dhaas gu ux gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' naaka'n bɨx gu suudai' gu jodai' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Amoon; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' jix dhaas gu ux gu gɨ'kora' pai' gu Josiiyas gu mar.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tasi' gu takarui' ka't gu Josiiyas na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu dhi' gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu Dabii gu taat cham gu ñi'ook kɨɨ'n tu' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' gu tasi' gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook kua'da' gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; gio ba' gu kutun gu takarui' kua'da' gu suudai' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' jix duu jix duñia' vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu Baales gu chuukug gu tas mi'p gu oi'ñga'n tu jiim; gio ba' jix duñia' gio gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu takarui' jix duñia' tu jiim oo' bhaan pai'm gu suudai' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' o'oo jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jɨ'dɨlh gu Manasees gu Epraim gu Simeoon bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chuukug xikoolh.
Jano' ba' na ja'p ka't gu o'o jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu jodai' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' bɨx duiñxim gu ux bɨx gu oidha' gu Israeel jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' gu vaak bhañ gu Sapaan gu mar gu Asaliias gu Maasiias gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' kiicham gu Joa gu mar gu Joakâs gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa tuumiñ ka't jix duñia' gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu Lebitas nukadham ki'ñgob gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Manasees gu Epraim bɨx gu suudai' gu Israeel bɨx gu Judaa gu Benjamiin gu oi'ñga'n mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' kapbhai' gu novɨ duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' daam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' duñia' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu takarui' na ba' jugi gu jodai tɨ'ya' gu u'u na ba' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu suudai' gu vaak gu suudai' gu jodai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu takarui' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Jaat gu tanoolh gu Lebitas gu ma'nkam gu Merari; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu Mesullam gu ma'nkam gu Koat na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Lebitas bɨx pui'm gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak.
Jano' ba' gio jix duñia' bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' daam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Lebitas ka't gu o'o gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tuumiñ ka't jix duñia' gu jodai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ilkiias jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu ux gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' jix maa jix duñia' gu ilkiias gu Sapaan gu o'o; gio ba' tu' gaagam u'uan ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu ilkiias u'uan gu Sapaan.
